dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You want to go to Narukami Island?

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: Yeah, staying in Ritou is so boring.

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: And I have already escorted my employer to Inazuma safely. The job is considered done anyway. Isn't it up to me, then, where I want to go next?

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: It's such a rare opportunity. I even passed through that stormy ocean. Why shouldn't I go see the world a bit more?

dialogues.speaker: Master Qin "Thunder Hand"
dialogues.text: Since I am here, I have to figure out what it's like to live in Inazuma, haha!
